# runr_workflow_app (Resource)

The workflow app of a project (or of one of its environments): where the workflow engine calls the workflows' code ([workflows](https://runr.sh/docs/workflows/)). By default that is the project's function; `endpoint_url` points the engine at a function served outside RunR instead, which verifies the engine's calls with the app's signing key (`RUNR_WORKFLOW_SIGNING_KEY`, from `runr workflows app signing-key`). Rotating the key is an action (`runr workflows app rotate-key`), not configuration.

Destroying the resource goes back to the project's function. Needs `workflows.manage`. Import with `<project name or id>` or `<project name or id>/<environment>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The workflows of the staging environment run in a function served outside RunR; it verifies
# the engine's calls with RUNR_WORKFLOW_SIGNING_KEY (`runr workflows app signing-key --env staging`).
resource "runr_workflow_app" "staging" {
  project_id   = runr_project.orders.id
  environment  = "staging"
  endpoint_url = "https://workflows-staging.example.com/runr"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) Project id.

### Optional

- `endpoint_url` (String) URL the engine calls instead of the project's function (a public http or https address). Left out: the project's function; an override set outside Terraform is then removed.
- `environment` (String) The project environment (name or id). Left out: the project's own workload (production).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<project_id>` or `<project_id>/<environment>`.
- `key_fingerprint` (String) Fingerprint of the current signing key (changes when the key is rotated).
- `url` (String) The URL the engine calls: `endpoint_url`, else the function's URL.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <project name or id> (the project's own workload) or <project name or id>/<environment>
terraform import runr_workflow_app.orders orders-api
terraform import runr_workflow_app.staging orders-api/staging
```
